fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Open Green Space; Detached Structure; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Fenced Sections
fr.recommendations:
• Install reflective address markers at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles approaching the main residence.
• Mark the locations of any gates along the perimeter fencing with reflective indicators visible from the road.
• Keep gates providing rear access unlocked or secured with a breakaway lock to allow responders to reach the back of the property without delay.
• Clear a direct walking path between the front parking area and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without navigating around landscaping.
• Thin dense vegetation adjacent to the access drive to maintain sightlines for responders moving on foot or in vehicles.
• Post the property address visibly at each access point if multiple entry points serve different sides of the property.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items so responding units can stage close to the residence.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Brush Area; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Near Structure; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Open Terrain; Multiple Access Routes; Scattered Shrubs; Ground Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to create more open space between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to the structure.
• Cut back ground vegetation growing up to the base of the structure.
• Trim low-hanging branches on scattered trees closest to the structure.
• Clear brush from the area adjacent to the structure where brush growth is visible.
• Keep scattered shrubs near the structure trimmed low and separated from one another.
• Maintain open ground between the brush area and the structure by removing encroaching vegetation.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and low vegetation along their edges.
• Mow or cut ground vegetation along the driveway and access routes to keep them passable.
• Remove dead or dry material from within shrub groupings near the structure.
